subject.title: [Bug]: Google vertex is now called Google Enterprise AI

question: What exact user-facing label should OpenClaw use for the google-vertex provider after Google's Vertex AI rebrand?
rationale: The source repro is clear, but the accepted label is a product/copy decision and the provider id must remain stable unless maintainers intentionally choose a migration.

options.title: Use Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (Vertex AI)
options.body: Update visible labels and docs to the current Google wording while keeping google-vertex as the stable provider/config/auth id.

options.title: Use Google Enterprise AI
options.body: Match the reporter's suggested wording even though it was not the exact official wording found in the checked Google Cloud page output.

options.title: Keep Google Vertex AI for now
options.body: Leave the current OpenClaw label until maintainers decide that Google's rebrand should be reflected across provider UI and docs.

recommendation.title: Use Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (Vertex AI)
recommendation.body: Update visible labels and docs to the current Google wording while keeping google-vertex as the stable provider/config/auth id.

likelyOwner.reason: This login has the strongest recent history across the provider display, Google plugin contract, and onboarding catalog surfaces involved in the copy decision.
